question: Under a clock that leaves events open, does saddle-aware GFN2-xTB guidance on the geometry shift the final event toward lower-barrier catalogue channels, beyond no push and a matched random push?
data_scope: V1a development parents only (62 parents, 21 formula groups)
generator: frozen V1a joint generator, training seeds 0,1,2; 32 proposals per parent per seed; same semantic noise keys as geoinfo/geolead, so every arm starts from the same (b0, x0)

clock.why: widest window at no measurable quality cost in geolead-1 (34.6%); chosen from development results, disclosed

window.why: the frozen V1a geometry-guidance interval; not tuned here

push.evaluated_on: predicted endpoint x1_hat = x_t + (1 - t_x) v_x, from the OLD state of the step
push.physics: GFN2-xTB (tblite) gradient, settings of configs/explore/geometry_information.json xtb block
push.saddle: G = (I - 2 u u^T) F, F = -gradient, u = unit reaction coordinate of the predicted bond-order change b1_hat - b_r on x1_hat (xtbflow.v1.explore_rollout.event_direction)
push.descent: G = F (the flawed energy-descent form, negative control)
push.random: one isotropic direction per trajectory (addressed seed 'explore_physics_random'), fixed over the window
push.step: unit-RMS direction times alpha * dt_x with the V1a per-atom cap (xtbflow.v1.guidance.geometry_step); only geometry is moved
push.applied_when: x1_hat has no interatomic distance < 0.5 A; physics arms also need a successful xTB gradient; saddle also needs a nonzero u
push.alpha_note: 0.3 is the frozen V1a alpha_x; 1.0 is a single stronger level; both reported, none chosen by result

outcomes.primary: event_utility of the final candidate (V1a proxy: max(0, 1 - (Ea_event - Ea_best)/10) for catalogue events, else 0), mean over seeds and proposals per parent
secondary: share of trajectories whose final event differs from the none arm
catalogue barrier shift among trajectories ending in catalogue events in both arms

interval: paired by parent, formula-cluster sandwich t, two-sided 95%

reading.per_arm: for saddle_* and descent_*, from the utility difference with none and with the random arm of the same alpha
reading.PHYSICS_REWRITES_TOWARD_LOW_BARRIER: vs none lower bound > 0 and vs random lower bound > 0
reading.SHIFT_NOT_SPECIFIC: vs none lower bound > 0 but vs random interval reaches 0

reproduction_check: the none arm under the recorded rollout must reproduce the geolead-1 geometry_lead3 rows: identical final events and proxy statuses; commit-step agreement reported (endpoint predictions now come from direct velocities)
